verdict.rationale: The evidence describes only SOSPortal, an account-based web portal for filing, ordering, searching and tracking. Nothing in the pack documents a system-to-system channel such as system accounts, transmitter or batch-provider programs, or an API, and no enrollment path for one is published. SOSUpload is mentioned only by name as being replaced, with no description of it as a machine channel, and the robots.txt probe concerns crawler access, not a sanctioned integration rail.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, a documented system-to-system channel exists for software to transact with the service (system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers), with the enrollment path published
